thread:
Oliver Park: OrchidPay POC kickoff notes. scope: document search over contracts + two tool calls (create_payment, dispute_payment). Sales asked for SOW, acceptance metrics, model guidance (context limits), and a rough committed price for ~10k q/day. customer requests a short 2-week pilot.

Samir Das: high-level acceptance ideas: precision@3 >= 0.82 on labeled intents, E2E tool-call correctness >= 97% (schema + side-effect validation), search-path p95 < 500ms, and no customer-data exfiltration incidents during trial. include a cost ceiling per query. :heavy_check_mark:

Rina Kapoor: model recommendations: start with 16k context family for a balance of cost/recall. run a lightweight 32k smoke test on 10% of docs to measure delta. pipeline: embeddings index (HNSW) -> ANN top200 -> prompt-based rerank -> generator for tool payloads. fallback: chunking + 8k if token-cost cap exceeded.

Diego Morales: timeline: Day0-2 connectors + sample prompts, Day3-6 embed + index + recall checks, Day7-9 reranker tuning + prompt templates, Day10 integrate tool calls + E2E smoke, Day11 stakeholder demo. Need 60 labeled prompts from OrchidPay by Day2.

Oliver Park: SOW acceptance criteria to propose: (1) precision@3 >= 0.82 on Orchid labeled set, (2) token cost per query <= $0.0035 (hosted) or equivalent committed rate, (3) tool-call success >= 97%, (4) no security blockers. Add rollback to 8k & explicit chunking.

Rina Kapoor: embeddings sizing: Orchid estimates ~120k docs, avg 4KB -> ~480M tokens. start with 768-d embeddings; if recall low, test 1024-d. storage estimate ~20-30GB compressed. recommend nightly incremental refresh and webhook-driven immediate embed for invoice events.

Samir Das: security asks from OrchidPay: SAML SSO + SCIM, BYOK via customer KMS, 12mo audit log retention, SOC2 report + pen test summary, and a completed security questionnaire. they said they'd return questionnaire within 48 hours. add breach SLA into SOW.

Diego Morales: ops checklist: service account, scoped keys, KMS role mapping, SSO test user, logging forwarding. InfraBot please create infra ticket and stash service creds.

InfraBot: ORCHID-POC-2124909999 created, infra ticket INF-8999 opened, service account provisioned, KMS onboarding pending customer auth.

Rina Kapoor: POC metrics to collect: precision@1/3/5, recall@10, avg tokens per query, token cost, p50/p95 latency for search & gen, tool-call success rate, PII redaction FP/FN. We'll instrument these in the SOW.

Samir Das: pricing ask: Finance needs usage profile (10k q/day -> ~300k q/mo). propose two options: hosted metered example + reserved monthly commit with lower unit. I'll ping finance for draft numbers.

Oliver Park: sample curl for POC engineer (semantic search + rerank):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/semsearch \
  -d '{"query":"How do I dispute a payment?","top_k":200,"rerank":true,"model":"rwd-16k-search"}'
```
Diego Morales: engineer checklist: 1) validate 16k latency on a sampled subset, 2) instrument token-cost by route, 3) implement strict schema validation for tool-call payloads and a replay test for side-effects, 4) add canary flag for rerank A/B.

Samir Das: blockers to surface on sales call: (1) security questionnaire completion, (2) finance commit pricing approval, (3) customer-provided prompt set and SSO test creds, (4) 16k model latency validation.

Rina Kapoor: I'll draft the SOW tonight with timeline, acceptance criteria, prompt-eval plan (60 labeled prompts across 5 intents), rollback plan, and instrumentation hooks. Oliver, Samir please review tomorrow.

Oliver Park: thanks team. next sync Mon 10am PT. Diego, please attach runbook for POC engineer to the SOW doc. :rocket:
